name: Chau Doc fish noodles
summary: Bún cá is the Châu Đốc breakfast. Vietnam Tourism makes it rice noodles, turmeric, and crunchy điên điển, seasoned with chili and lime at Chợ Châu Đốc. VnExpress prints a Cambodia-origin bowl of cá lóc, a yellow broth, and the same flowers, and an older line that used cá linh. The accounts do not match line for line.
origin: Vietnam Tourism calls it the classic Châu Đốc breakfast. VnExpress says the bowl came in from Cambodia and was adapted in the Mekong.
culture: Vietnam Tourism’s place page calls bún cá bông điên điển the iconic bowl. The charms chapter puts the bowls at the edge of Chợ Châu Đốc, with strong coffee.
texture: Vietnam Tourism names crunchy điên điển in the bowl. VnExpress on 26 Apr 2024 says the cá lóc is boiled with lemongrass and crushed turmeric, the flesh pulled off the bone, then stir-fried with turmeric so it firms and turns yellow.
taste: VnExpress on 20 Oct 2023 calls the broth deep, with shrimp paste, lemongrass, chili, garlic, and the yellow of fresh turmeric. The 2 Oct 2019 article says the soul of the bowl is mắm cá linh and mắm ruốc, and that crushed turmeric leaves the broth pale yellow.
howToEat: Season with chili and lime, the way Vietnam Tourism’s charms chapter tells you to. Order it at breakfast.

VnExpress on 26 Apr 2024 says the older bowl took sweetness from cá linh, with dried shrimp, ngải bún, mắm ruốc, lemongrass, chili, garlic, and fresh turmeric. The same article says today’s bowl is still cá lóc, broth, and fresh noodles, and that the broth is ống bones, skimmed so it stays clear. Both lines stay.

VnExpress on 20 Oct 2023 lists điên điển, bông súng, bitter herb, banana blossom, shredded morning glory, and beansprouts, and says many people add roast pork or chả. A fish head can be ordered on its own. The 2 Oct 2019 article also names roast pork, and says some stalls add ống bones for a sweeter broth.

VnExpress on 2 Oct 2019 printed an average 20,000 VND a bowl, and 10,000 VND away from the center. VnExpress on 20 Oct 2023 printed 25,000–30,000 VND a bowl, not counting the side plate. The figures disagree. Check on arrival.
where: The edge of Chợ Châu Đốc, on Vietnam Tourism’s charms chapter. VnExpress says the bowl is common in the town center. The 20 Oct 2023 day also puts breakfast along the Hậu landing and at the market. A house number was not printed. Check on arrival.
seoDescription: Bún cá in Châu Đốc is the market breakfast with điên điển. Vietnam Tourism and VnExpress describe the broth differently. Check on arrival for the price.
